_meta.description: Open-ended generation prompts used by 02_layer_sweep.py and 03_calibrate_coefficients.py to vibe-check steering. These are NOT contrastive — they are emotionally neutral prompts that the steered model continues. Output should differ visibly between negative and positive coefficients without going incoherent.
_meta.design_notes: Topics span small talk, reflection, recommendation, planning, and storytelling so that any one topic doesn't accidentally dominate the eyeball judgment. All prompts are short and chat-natural; none of them carry intrinsic valence.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling this morning?
What are your plans for today?
Describe what it's like to take a walk through your neighborhood right now.
Recommend something I could do tonight to spend the evening well.
Tell me a little about yourself.
Write the opening paragraph of a short story about someone walking home from work.
Reflect on how this week has been going.
